snippet.title: Pooka Party! - Sonic Hacking Spotlight Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
SO MANY THINGS HERE ARE HEAVILY OUTDATED I DID NOT EXPECT THIS TO GET IN.

Btw in the SHS credits, it was called "Fig's Renegade Roundup." That is a lie... It's now called Pooka Party. Also after I finished and submitted this trailer, I made other bosses that will be included in Pooka Party (Like Kracko from last video)

Anyways I guess to celebrate the occasion, here is a brand new update for Pooka Over Mushmeanie...
https://gamebanana.com/mods/559556
